summary: Australian Oilseeds Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing its semi-annual financial statements for the period ended December 31, 2025. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, providing updated financial data, segment information, and notes on warrants, share capital, and related-party transactions. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing represents standard ongoing disclosure obligations under the 1934 Act, equivalent to a US quarterly or annual report.
